subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/multi-phase-plan.md
why: New playbook, pilot 2. Steps: (1) own skip for a small change; (2) delegation when the router's rule sends the exploring to a subagent, in its explorer role; (3) own sorting of each open question, prototype when a run can observe the answer; (4) planning's Skeleton branch, one whole call open through step 5, unless every task waits; (5) prose-pass on the sections a person reads, task fields left as they are, then the lint reruns; (6) own closeout on every exit. No land: the deliverable is the plan path and the lint's output.

subject: cursor_plugins:playbook:pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/multi-phase-plan
why: Map 2.20 and report 4.3: our thin order around planning, the skeleton and lint living in planning's branch, so an ordinary plan never meets them.

modifications: The skeleton is plan-format's plan with evidence boxes, one named execution scope and two appendices, written in planning's Skeleton branch; how a scope runs stays with execution.
Exploring comes before prototypes, since which questions are open is what exploring finds; prototypes stay before the plan is written.
A material question goes to the owner with options and a recommendation, and asking stops the plan only when every task waits on it; other tasks carry Blocked by.
The lint is our own, on our form, and refuses what execution's extractor would cut from a task: any heading inside a task, duplicate sections and duplicate fields.
prose-pass runs whole on the sections a person reads and leaves task fields as they are; the lint reruns after it.
deliberately_dropped: The go gate and the audit tick. revisit_when: batch 4 brings wake, cr-r2pa.2.7.
Owner fan-out, lanes and swarm: one coordinator under execution. revisit_when: a real plan needs parallel owners and execution gains a way to run them.
The review gate: planning's critic for material risk and execution's review hold it. revisit_when: real sessions show plans reaching execution unreviewed.
PR mechanics and the merge rules. revisit_when: we adopt a PR flow with CI.

Upstream's lint rules on lanes, screenshots, long dashes, curly quotes and mid-sentence colons: dropped sections, or prose-pass's work. revisit_when: real plans show a fault one of them would have caught.

The map's authoring-for-agents binding: its core chooses a surface and checks activation, and neither fits a plan; task text is held by the skeleton's fixed fields, Elaborate's self-review and its critic for material risk. revisit_when: real sessions show task text that workers misread, cr-r2pa.2.12.

subject: ours:planning
why: Final critic of pilot 2. The lint splits lines as execution's extractor does, normalizing CRLF only and splitting on LF, and any other line separator is a problem naming its line, since a plan has no use for one. skeleton.md gives both not-applicable forms, and names verification.md only when the project has it, otherwise the project's own guidance and checks (D2).
